Substantial lime/green leaves and the rounded continuous golden rim visibly improve on the previous thin foliage and exposed narrow stems while preserving plant identity.

The narrow dark contact line inside the rear rim is coherent cavity shading, not an intrusive black wedge or dead corner. No substantive source defect is revealed by this pinned camera.

Page 0 retains Belt 6, Stool 4, Plant 2, Crate 2; page 1 retains Barrel 1. Floor remains the accepted slab preview without extra labels.

Independent native source inspection and immutable replay establish that this is the approved native plant under the original static actions and UI camera. It is not a flattened world sprite, image card, raster fitted substitute or retouched export.
